decisions.reason: Having already remained on the market after launch, this track spotlight line sits squarely within the firm's existing design, LED and system-selling knowledge, so management would expect continued refinement rather than withdrawal.

This ceiling luminaire line is also highly related to the firm's established competences and customer channels, which gives it strong absorptive capacity to interpret market feedback and improve the offer.
As a newly launched but closely related flexible LED spotlight range, it is likely to be retained because the firm can learn quickly from early installer, dealer and planner response and adapt it.

The multi-outlet ceiling canopy builds on the firm's established modular lighting systems, so its technical fit with the existing portfolio makes continued development more likely than discontinuation.

Although somewhat more specialised, this low-voltage multi-outlet canopy still draws on the firm's related system and planning knowledge, so management would usually keep it to support the broader lighting architecture.

This glass track luminaire line is close to the firm's core offer but appears less prominently positioned so far, making it the most vulnerable of the six, though still likely to be kept because the firm has relevant design and commercial capabilities to improve it.
